 AstroDevam , Anita Baranwal & Dr Achary Kalki Krishnan / TOI Astrology / Oct 29, 2026, 02:00 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print General: A productive start to the day comes from engaging discussions and collaborative plans. The Moon rises in Taurus, positioned in your eleventh house, encouraging interaction with friends, groups, and those linked to your ambitions. By evening, the Moon shifts into Gemini in your twelfth house, prompting a desire for solitude and a calmer tempo. Should guests or an invitation disrupt your schedule, build in enough flexibility to enjoy their company while still carving out personal time. Love and Relationship: Your language can convey warmth, making it simpler to show affection. With Jupiter exalted in Cancer in your first house, you’re inclined toward thoughtfulness, generosity, and a stronger trust in your own decisions. Let that confidence also involve truly hearing another person’s wishes. When you’re entertaining a guest, straightforward hospitality will put everyone at ease. A partner might value being part of the decision‑making process regarding home arrangements, rather than learning about them after they’re finalized. Education and Career: Revisit a previous discussion while the day still supports collaborative efforts. Making a specific request can enable a coworker or friend to provide the appropriate help. With retrograde Saturn in Pisces occupying your ninth house, careful preparation becomes essential for long‑term learning, travel, and interactions with mentors. Verify any application criteria or gather study resources before asking for advice. Learners will likely gain more from a teacher’s proven approach, especially if they’ve been trying to tackle too much material all at once. Money and Finance: Creating a financial cushion for tomorrow requires focus today. With Rahu positioned in Aquarius in your eighth house and Ketu placed in Leo in your second house, an axis emerges that urges transparency regarding joint finances, responsibilities, and personal savings. Examine both the accessibility of your funds and the total amount you have. If you’re contemplating an investment, weigh its expenses, conditions, and how well it fits your timeline. A composed assessment of your current obligations will guide you in determining what can be comfortably earmarked. Health and Well-being: A weakened Mars positioned in Cancer in your first house calls for a sensible, steady pace, especially when excitement tempts you to add more tasks. Opt for a realistic workload and allow yourself time to recuperate afterward. The calm, quieter phase of the Moon tonight is ideal for a simple dinner, less screen time, and a tidy bedtime routine. You’ll likely feel better by ending social interactions while they’re still pleasant, rather than dragging an enjoyable day into fatigue. Tip for the Day: Review your emergency savings and choose one realistic amount to reserve.
